manifest.purpose: Hardened HLS scratchpad kernel implementing exact pinned interface: `int kernel_access(int32_t scratchpad[BUFFER_SIZE], int32_t index, int32_t op, int32_t write_val, int32_t *status)` with `constexpr int32_t BUFFER_SIZE = 64;` (no #define to avoid macro clashes with harness, but value must be 64). Includes <cstdint>, no exceptions/STL/dynamic allocation. Logic: validate `index >= 0 && index < BUFFER_SIZE` BEFORE any array touch (no pointer arithmetic prior to check, no casts that could wrap); if invalid, set *status=1 and return 0 without touching scratchpad. Then check op: if op==0 (READ), set *status=0, return scratchpad[index]. If op==1 (WRITE), scratchpad[index]=write_val, set *status=0, return write_val. Any other op (not 0 or 1) sets *status=1, returns 0, no array access. Comparison uses signed int32_t index against BUFFER_SIZE directly (safe since BUFFER_SIZE small positive constant, no overflow risk from index<0 check done first via short-circuit). This single file is the complete deliverable; no main() included; must compile standalone as a translation unit included/compiled alongside a harness main().
